name: Every event and control reaches a frontend as plain data, with the run facts and no terminal leaks
purpose: A separate frontend gets every event and control of a session, and the facts a person looks for (cost, helpers, changed files, steer acknowledgement, pending input), as plain data that names nothing of a terminal.
record: One number: the share of scripted cases right, balanced with time by [balance.frontend_interface]; weights and budgets fixed in esoi.toml before any arm was scored. Kinds of case (evaluation/frontend_interface/build_cases.py): event (each of the eight event kinds round-trips through JSON to an equal event), control (each of the five control kinds does), facts (cost, helpers with parent and solution, changed files, steer sent then taken up, pending question, outcome with blocked and unseen), leak (no escape code, key hint or terminal wording in the data) and unknown (an event of a type nobody knows is kept apart). All free: events and expected values are written by hand from the contract.
disadvantages: Scripted cases prove the data is complete and plain, not that a real frontend draws it well; a real web page on a real harness is the later stage. The leak check looks for a fixed list of terminal markers.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new way to carry the session is described: rate it on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the free contract-coverage cases pass] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a real frontend draws a real session from this data and a person reads it] > free [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the arm was recorded on the same cases]
